game.description: 证明完毕 Q.E.D.：把形式化证明做成一套解谜关卡。Formal proof as a set of puzzle levels.
game.lede: No logic background is required. Start with truth tables, connect inference rules into proofs, and learn assumptions, case analysis, quantifiers and induction as you build a proof assistant.
game.title: Q.E.D.
glossary.entries.map.body.0: Levels are arranged in chapters. After the pen-and-paper exercises, each chapter adds a module to the same prover, retaining earlier capabilities as the course specifies. Passing a level unlocks those whose prerequisites are met; topics and challenges are optional branches.
glossary.entries.map.title: level map
glossary.entries.proofBoard.body.0: When a part requires a proposition, select one from the choices available in the level.
glossary.entries.proofBoard.body.1: Each level has tests: one uses the letter schema, while the others substitute everyday propositions. The circuit must pass each test. Tests expose mismatches; a general conclusion rests on the proof structure and its substitution rules, not on a few examples alone.
glossary.entries.proofBoard.title: Proof and substitution tests
